arabicExcerpts.text: فَقَالَ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ يُؤۡثَرُ

وَمَا جَعَلۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةٗۖ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا عِدَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِيَسۡتَيۡقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَيَزۡدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنٗا وَلَا يَرۡتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَا يَعۡلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡبَشَرِ

mainSubject.label: Leave to Allah the one He created alone granting extensive wealth, present children and eased life, yet who desires more while remaining obstinate toward divine verses — he will be covered with arduous torment; his thinking and deliberation cursed twice, followed by frowning, scowling, turning back arrogantly and dismissing revelation as imitated magic or mere human speech; the verdict: Saqar that leaves nothing unburned and blackens skins, overseen by nineteen angels whose number serves as a trial so Scripture-recipients are convinced, believers increase in faith, neither group doubts, while hypocrites and disbelievers question the example — thus Allah misguides and guides by will, none knowing His soldiers except Him, with the Fire's mention serving as humanity's reminder
